authorization: Implementation of the September 17 finite 528-group extension, continued under the September 18 instruction: finish it and you have permission to check and edit as much as you need to to get the dividend portion of this done.
rules: Primary issuer/depositary terms resolve each exact original whole group. No provider record is discarded.
Gross USD per listed share or ADR; preserve distinct cash payments and record/pay dates. Published issuer conversion rates may establish USD gross cash; no investor net-cash claim.
Current primary histories establish terms, not historical publication. Effective-session availability remains an explicit retrospective reconstruction assumption.
One combined price adjustment; each positive cash component accrues at that ex-open and releases separately at the first captured regular open strictly after its reviewed pay date.
The original funded beneficial-share, zero-withholding/fee model and settlement coverage requirements remain. No real fills or broker postings inferred.
Mixed security entitlements, due bills, missing dated identity or raw prior close require separate resolved treatment.
